an5.2:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an5.2:2.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an5.2:3.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako hirīmā hoti hiriyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
an5.2:4.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako ottappī hoti ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
an5.2:5.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an5.2:6.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
an5.2:7.2: saddhābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena hirībalena … ottappabalena … viriyabalena … paññābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalenāti
